tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: List all database schemas available in the PostgreSQL instance.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List objects in a schema: tables, views, sequences or extensions.

tools.name: get_object_details
tools.description: Show detailed information about a database object, such as a table's columns, constraints and indexes.

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Execute SQL statements on the database; limited to read-only operations in restricted mode.

tools.name: explain_query
tools.description: Explain the execution plan for a SQL query, optionally with hypothetical indexes.

analyze.description: Actually run the query to get real timings.

tools.name: get_top_queries
tools.description: Report the slowest SQL queries by total or mean execution time, using pg_stat_statements.

tools.name: analyze_workload_indexes
tools.description: Analyze the database workload to identify resource-intensive queries and recommend indexes for them.

max_index_size_mb.description: Maximum total size of recommended indexes.

tools.name: analyze_query_indexes
tools.description: Analyze a list of up to 10 specific SQL queries and recommend indexes for them.

max_index_size_mb.description: Maximum total size of recommended indexes.

tools.name: analyze_db_health
tools.description: Run database health checks: buffer cache, connections, constraints, indexes, sequences and vacuum.
